item.title: Peyton Watson, Scottie Barnes Named Players Of Week
item.description: Nuggets wing Peyton Watson and Raptors forward Scottie Barnes have been named the Western and Eastern Conference Players of the Week, respectively, according to NBA Communications (Twitter links). Watson led the depleted Nuggets to a 3-1 record last week, posting averages of 24.5 points and 8.0 rebounds while making 70 percent of his 3-point attempts. […]

item.title: Celtics’ Jaylen Brown Fined $35K By NBA
item.description: Celtics star Jaylen Brown has been fined $35K for “public criticism of the officiating” following Saturday’s game vs. San Antonio, the NBA announced today (via Twitter). The fine was anticipated after Brown went on a prolonged rant about the officials, including calling out crew chief Curtis Blair by name, after Boston attempted four free throws […]
